POSITIVE_FINDINGS: Every ACTIVE reconciliation decision is now required to carry final DOC-C normative incorporation within primary paragraphs 9886..10499.
Final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal requirements are retained as ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE with PROHIBIT polarity.
ACTIVE_BUILD root now binds source-enumeration and complete authority-reconciliation roots and forbids unresolved reconciliation.
Mutable accounting/evidence status is excluded from denominator roots.
The zero-based matrix to one-based primary paragraph transform is explicitly defined and agrees with sampled matrix/final-index boundaries.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH and DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH require hash-bearing obligation_id fields, but V2 defines only type=string and no canonical derivation/domain from source_entry_id, polarity, authority refs, or requirement identity. Two conforming materializers can choose different IDs for the same obligation and produce different roots.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define one deterministic obligation identity object plus exact JCS/SHA-256 or other canonical derivation, collision handling, and uniqueness rule; use it identically in active-build and deployment roots.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH introduces PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION but does not define deterministic source_entry_id generation or the equivalence test for whether a final DOC-C normative obligation is already represented by a matrix row. Different peers can disagree on omission count and identity while each follows the prose rule.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define a canonical final-DOC-C obligation enumeration/anchor manifest, deterministic matrix-to-primary matching/equivalence rule, deterministic omission source_entry_id derivation, and explicit duplicate/conflict behavior.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: validation_acceptance_criteria is mandatory and hash-bearing for active-build and deployment entries, but V2 does not define how criteria are derived from locked Spec text, source anchors, or immutable evidence. Free-form paraphrase can alter both denominator identity and closure semantics.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Bind each criterion to exact authoritative source refs and define deterministic extraction/normalization or use immutable criterion records with independently verified IDs/hashes; forbid free-form unbound synthesis inside denominator roots.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: Matrix normalization preserves Dependencies only as dependencies_source_text, while ACTIVE_BUILD entries require dependencies_identity as source_entry_id strings. V2 defines no deterministic parser/resolver from source dependency text or normative relations to those IDs.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define canonical dependency extraction and resolution, unresolved/ambiguous dependency state, ordering, self/cycle handling, and fail-closed rules before root materialization.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: Reconciliation reference/evidence fields have no exact JSON object schema. The normalization contract mentions paragraph_1_based+anchor reference ordering while some field names can also be read as integer arrays; supporting_refs likewise names canonical reference objects without defining their exact fields.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact reference/evidence object schemas, required/nullable fields, integer/string types, source identity, anchor normalization, duplicate rules, and canonical sorting for every hash-bearing reference array.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: Reconciliation defines DECISIONS and POLARITY_VALUES but no mandatory decision-to-polarity matrix. ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_POSITIVE can therefore be paired with PROHIBIT or ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE with REQUIRE without an explicit schema rejection, allowing semantic inversion.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define and validate an exact decision/polarity matrix: positive->REQUIRE, negative->PROHIBIT, plus the allowed polarity for every non-active decision; reject all other pairs.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: V2 repairs matrix column types and ACTIVE_BUILD entry types, but exact JSON types/nullability remain absent for multiple ROOT_OBJECT fields, reconciliation entries, PRIMARY_OMISSION entries, deployment entries, generation/count fields, and evidence references. RR5 is therefore only partially repaired.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Provide complete machine-checkable type contracts for every hash-domain field across all roots, including null/empty representation and integer bounds where applicable.
